remarks: Great Luxury Living in this spacious beautifully decorated and recently updated Town house. This unit has great flow with open concept, Hardwood Floors on the main level. Enjoy the sun coming through sliders which lead out to a covered DECK, great space for your morning coffee or evening beverage. WOOD BURNING FIREPLACE will keep you warm in winter. Eat-in-kitchen has newer SS appliances, custom made cabinets & granite counter tops. Main bathroom has a jetted tub for total relaxation. Both bedrooms are extra large with double closets and attached Full Baths. Washer and dryer are located in the hallway for your convenience on 2nd floor. Lower level has storage area next to ATTACHED GARAGE! Enjoy beautiful Swimming pool. Great location for everything. Walk to new train station, only one minute away. Close to Route 7, Merritt and I95.  Don't miss great opportunity!
